Personal Injury Case Evaluation

Find out where your claim stands.

A no-cost review of your injury claim by BAM Personal Injury Lawyers. Tell us what happened and our team looks at fault, insurance coverage, your medical treatment, and the deadlines that apply, then tells you plainly whether you have a case and what the next step is. Available for car, truck, motorcycle, pedestrian, and bicycle accidents, slip and falls, dog bites, and wrongful death claims in Utah and Idaho.

  • Review of fault, insurance coverage, and your injuries
  • A straight answer on whether you have a claim
  • The deadlines that apply to your case

Strongly-Worded Letter to the Insurance Co.

Put the insurance company on notice, in writing.

Is the insurance company stalling, lowballing, or ignoring you? Start with a free review of your claim. If we take your case, an attorney at BAM Personal Injury Lawyers sends the insurer a formal letter on firm letterhead: it tells the adjuster you are represented, directs all communication to our office, demands that evidence be preserved, and lays out your claim. No upfront cost, and no fee unless we recover money for you. For injury claims in Utah and Idaho.

  • Tells the adjuster to deal with your lawyer, not you
  • Demands that evidence be preserved
  • No upfront cost; no fee unless we recover

Attorney advertising. Services are offered for personal injury claims in Utah and Idaho. Submitting your information or calling does not create an attorney-client relationship; representation begins only when you and the firm sign a written fee agreement.

“Free” means there is no charge for the evaluation or consultation and no upfront cost. If the firm represents you, attorney fees are contingent on a recovery and are a percentage of it; case costs may be deducted from the recovery as described in the fee agreement. A letter to an insurance company is sent only after the firm agrees to represent you. Every case is different, and past results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
